scripts.text:
[PVP Narrator]
Hello and welcome!
I am in charge of
explaining the PVP Modes.
I am the PVP Narrator!
scripts.translation:
[PVP解说员]
大家好，欢迎光临！
我负责解说PVP模式。
我是PVP解说员！

scripts.text: What is PVP?
scripts.translation: 什么是PVP？

scripts.text: What are the PVP Modes?
scripts.translation: PVP有哪些模式？

scripts.text: What are the rules for PVP?
scripts.translation: PVP的规则是什么？

scripts.text: Save Position.
scripts.translation: 保存位置

scripts.text: End Dialog.
scripts.translation: 结束对话

scripts.text:
[PVP Narrator]
In short, PVP means
' Player VS Player Mode '
It's a unique place for people
to duel with each other.
scripts.translation:
[PVP解说员]
简单来说，PVP就是
“玩家VS玩家模式”。
这是一个供玩家
相互决斗的独特场所。

scripts.text:
[PVP Narrator]
Just tell the
^3355FFGate Keeper^000000
that you want to try. He will
let you enter the PVP square.
scripts.translation:
[PVP解说员]
只要告诉
^3355FF守门人^000000
你想尝试即可。
他会让你进入PVP竞技场。

scripts.text:
[PVP Narrator]
But, you need to be at
least level 31. And you
must pay 500 zeny entrance fee in order
to enter a PVP fight square.
scripts.translation:
[PVP解说员]
但是，你的等级
至少需要达到31级。
并且必须支付500 Zeny的入场费，
才能进入PVP竞技场。

scripts.text:
[PVP Narrator]
When you are qualified, you
can choose one of the two modes.
Yoyo Mode or Nightmare Mode.
scripts.translation:
[PVP解说员]
当你符合条件时，
可以选择两种模式之一。
溜溜猴模式或梦魇模式。

scripts.text:
[PVP Narrator]
Yoyo Mode is risk free.
You can experience PVP
without any restriction or
punishment. It is recommended
that you practice your skills
here before you move on.
scripts.translation:
[PVP解说员]
溜溜猴模式没有风险。
你可以体验PVP，
没有任何限制或惩罚。
建议你先在这里
练习技能，然后再进阶。

scripts.text:
[PVP Narrator]
Nightmare Mode is very
dangerous! Please be cautious,
you will lose some of your
EXP when you are defeated. And
there is a small chance that
you will drop some equipment.
scripts.translation:
[PVP解说员]
梦魇模式非常危险！
请小心，当你被击败时，
会损失一部分经验值。
并且有小概率
掉落部分装备。

scripts.text:
[PVP Narrator]
However, if you win, the
rewards can be great!
To avoid misunderstanding,
you should think twice
before you go there...
Good Luck!
scripts.translation:
[PVP解说员]
不过，如果你获胜，
奖励可能会很丰厚！
为了避免误解，
在进入之前请三思...
祝你好运！

scripts.text:
[PVP Narrator]
Each of the fight squares
have a row of Narrators and
choose them based on your
qualifications.
scripts.translation:
[PVP解说员]
每个竞技场
都有一排解说员，
请根据你的资格
选择对应的解说员。

scripts.text:
[PVP Narrator]
Each Narrator will ask
which of the five PVP maps
you wish to go to.
Choose, and go in!
scripts.translation:
[PVP解说员]
每位解说员都会询问
你想去五个PVP地图中的哪一个。
做出选择，然后进入吧！

scripts.text:
[PVP Narrator]
Each map has a limitation on
the number of people who can
participate. So you will see
figures in the corner showing
'Attendee/Total'.
scripts.translation:
[PVP解说员]
每个地图对
参与人数有限制。
所以你会在角落看到
显示“当前人数/总人数”的数字。

scripts.text:
[PVP Narrator]
Also, there is a hidden EXP
value in PVP mode. This EXP
score will only apply inside
of the PVP zone, so do not
worry.
scripts.translation:
[PVP解说员]
此外，PVP模式中
有一个隐藏的经验值。
这个经验值分数
仅在PVP区域内生效，
所以不用担心。

scripts.text:
[PVP Narrator]
Every player's EXP at the
beginning is usually 5 points.
If you win, it will
increase by 1 point
scripts.translation:
[PVP解说员]
每位玩家开始时的
经验值通常是5点。
如果你获胜，
它会增加1点。

scripts.text:
[PVP Narrator]
In the same way, when you
lose... Your EXP will
drop by 5 points.
So be careful!
scripts.translation:
[PVP解说员]
同样地，当你
失败时...你的经验值
会减少5点。
所以请小心！

scripts.text:
[PVP Narrator]
When you are defeated
And your EXP is equal
to or less than 0,
You will be removed from PVP
and your duel is finished!
scripts.translation:
[PVP解说员]
当你被击败
且经验值小于或等于0时，
你将被移出PVP，
你的决斗就结束了！

scripts.text:
[PVP Narrator]
However, if your EXP is more
than 0. You can still get help
through other players healing...
Do you get it?
scripts.translation:
[PVP解说员]
不过，如果你的经验值大于0，
你仍然可以请求其他玩家的治疗...
你明白了吗？

scripts.text:
[PVP Narrator]
The fighting commands inside of
PVP are the same as the normal.
All the basic controls are the
same.
scripts.translation:
[PVP解说员]
PVP内的战斗指令与普通模式相同。
所有基本操作都是一样的。

scripts.text:
[PVP Narrator]
However, there is one thing...
Within the PVP fight square
and PVP fighting zones,
you cannot save your position.
Remember well... These rules
can help to ensure your victory.
scripts.translation:
[PVP解说员]
但是有一点...
在PVP战斗广场和PVP战斗区域内，
你无法保存位置。
请牢记...这些规则有助于确保你的胜利。

scripts.text:
[PVP Narrator]
Position successfully saved...
Thank you very much!
We will see you again soon.
scripts.translation:
[PVP解说员]
位置保存成功...
非常感谢！
期待再次见到你。

scripts.text:
[PVP Narrator]
With war raging between monsters
and humans, this competition
among people - PVP -
encourages us all to get
stronger. Come again,
we welcome your challenge!
scripts.translation:
[PVP解说员]
在魔物与人类的战争如火如荼之际，
这种人与人之间的竞争——PVP——
激励着我们要变得更强。欢迎再来，
我们期待你的挑战！

scripts.text:
[Gate Keeper]
Glad to be of service.
I will open the PVP fight
square for you! If you have
any questions about the PVP
modes or rules, Please ask
the Narrator...
scripts.translation:
[守门人]
很高兴为您服务。
我将为您打开PVP战斗广场！如果您有关于PVP模式或规则的问题，请询问解说员...
